Business-type from proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position (p7) Total column; no single printed total so reported_totals computed; gain on disposal treated as receipt (sale of assets). Governmental ending_cash is Total Governmental Funds cash and cash equivalents 4,298,911 (excludes county treasurer cash 62,193). Balance sheet uses government-wide Statement of Net Position Total column (p1); zero/dash lines omitted. Statement of Cash Flows (p8-9) page 8 shows only Water Fund; total column on p9. General Fund detail uses the departmental combining schedule (p16-17, more detailed); the General Fund budgetary comparison schedule (p10) is not recorded to avoid double counting. In that schedule loan proceeds 323,805 are printed within revenues so they are recorded as other financing with total includes. Street, Special Assessments and EMS detail from budgetary-basis schedules (actuals differ slightly from GAAP for Special Assessments). Nonmajor funds recorded per fund (Historic Lighting all dashes, omitted). Zero-actual lines (EMS capital outlay, budget 2,500) omitted. Combined lines: 'Salaries and benefits' categorized as salaries and wages; 'Debt service' lines in budget schedules combine principal and interest. Grants and contributions kept as donations/contributions (grantor not stated; review).
